project: ALSKwela A&E 2027 – Elementary LS1 Communication Skills in English
source: DepEd Bureau of Alternative Education, Revised ALS Curriculum Guide A&E Elementary LS1 English, 13 pages (uploaded)
design_status: Independent practice questions: teacher subject-matter review and learner pilot testing required; not official A&E examination items
language_policy: English questions and choices; professional encouraging Taglish feedback/explanations

items.stimulus: Before sunrise, Ana and her father brought vegetables to the riverside market. The boats were just arriving, and vendors were arranging their stalls.
items.question: Where does the story take place?
items.A: At a market beside the river
items.B: At a farm beside the school
items.C: At a park behind the hospital
items.D: At a classroom near the river
items.correct_text: At a market beside the river
items.feedback_correct: Excellent work! Naunawaan mo ang mahalagang clue sa tanong.
items.feedback_incorrect: You are improving! Balikan natin ang context bago pumili.
items.explanation: Makikita sa salitang riverside market at stalls ang setting. Ito ang lugar kung saan nagtitinda sina Ana.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: Berto found a small purse on the road. He wanted to buy a toy, but he took the purse to the barangay office instead.
items.question: What does Berto’s action show about him?
items.A: He wants to receive a prize immediately.
items.B: He chooses honesty over his own wish.
items.C: He plans to purchase a toy tomorrow.
items.D: He wishes to avoid visiting the market.
items.correct_text: He chooses honesty over his own wish.
items.feedback_correct: Great job! Tama ang iyong pagsusuri sa sitwasyon.
items.feedback_incorrect: Good attempt! Ihambing natin ang choices sa impormasyong ibinigay.
items.explanation: Pinili ni Berto na isauli ang purse kahit may gusto siyang bilhin. This choice shows honesty and responsibility.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: Lina practiced reading aloud every night. When she finished her first public reading, she smiled and held her certificate close.
items.question: How did Lina most likely feel afterward?
items.A: Afraid of reading anything again
items.B: Proud of what she had achieved
items.C: Angry at the people who listened
items.D: Uninterested in receiving her certificate
items.correct_text: Proud of what she had achieved
items.feedback_correct: Well done! Naipakita mo ang magandang reading and reasoning skills.
items.feedback_incorrect: Keep going! Ang review na ito ay paraan para mas mahasa ang iyong skills.
items.explanation: Her smile and how she held the certificate suggest pride. Gumamit tayo ng clues sa kilos para ma-infer ang feelings.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: First, Carlo planted a seed. Next, he watered the soil. After several days, a small shoot appeared.
items.question: What happened immediately before the shoot appeared?
items.A: Carlo moved the plant indoors.
items.B: Carlo sold the plant at market.
items.C: Carlo picked fruit from the plant.
items.D: Carlo watered the planted soil.
items.correct_text: Carlo watered the planted soil.
items.feedback_correct: Mahusay! Nahanap mo ang sagot gamit ang context.
items.feedback_incorrect: You can do it! Suriin natin kung bakit mas angkop ang tamang sagot.
items.explanation: The text says he watered the soil before the shoot appeared. Ang sequence words na first, next, at after help show order.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: During a power outage, two neighbors shared one lamp so their children could study. The next day, the families agreed to help each other whenever needed.
items.question: Which lesson is BEST supported by the story?
items.A: Cooperation can help people face difficulties.
items.B: Neighbors should avoid sharing personal belongings.
items.C: Studying is useful only during blackouts.
items.D: Borrowing lamps always causes family problems.
items.correct_text: Cooperation can help people face difficulties.
items.feedback_correct: Correct! Nagamit mo nang maayos ang lesson concept.
items.feedback_incorrect: Almost there! Gamitin ang explanation bilang guide sa susunod na item.
items.explanation: Ang shared lamp at pagtutulungan ang central idea. The story supports cooperation, not a rule about electricity or borrowing.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: NOTICE: The community library will open from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. on weekdays. Borrowers must return books within seven days.
items.question: What is the main purpose of this notice?
items.A: To describe a favorite childhood memory
items.B: To persuade everyone to purchase books
items.C: To inform readers about library rules
items.D: To entertain readers with a short story
items.correct_text: To inform readers about library rules
items.feedback_correct: Nice work! Tama ang iyong pagpili batay sa details.
items.feedback_incorrect: Good effort! Basahin natin muli ang mga clue at ang explanation.
items.explanation: Ang notice ay nagbibigay ng schedule at borrowing rule. Its main purpose is to inform, not entertain or advertise.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: A school report states: “The reading corner has 45 books.” A learner adds: “It is the best corner in our town.”
items.question: Which statement can be checked by counting?
items.A: The room looks more beautiful now.
items.B: The books are the most exciting.
items.C: The reading corner has 45 books.
items.D: The corner is the best in town.
items.correct_text: The reading corner has 45 books.
items.feedback_correct: Good thinking! Nasuri mo ang impormasyon nang mabuti.
items.feedback_incorrect: Keep learning! Tingnan natin kung aling detalye ang pinakamahalaga.
items.explanation: Maaaring bilangin ang 45 books to verify the statement. The other choices express opinions or judgments.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: A group claims that a water station reduced the use of disposable bottles at school.
items.question: Which information BEST supports the claim?
items.A: Bottle waste counts before and after installation
items.B: Photos of the school entrance only
items.C: A list of learners who enjoy recess
items.D: Opinions about the station’s bright paint
items.correct_text: Bottle waste counts before and after installation
items.feedback_correct: You got it! Malinaw ang pag-unawa mo sa halimbawa.
items.feedback_incorrect: Nice try! Gamitin natin ang paliwanag para mas malinaw ang concept.
items.explanation: Relevant evidence compares waste before and after the station. Ipinapakita nito kung nabawasan nga ang disposable bottles.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: An advertisement says, “If you love your family, you MUST buy this expensive water bottle today!” It gives no information about quality or safety.
items.question: What technique does the advertisement mainly use?
items.A: Emotional pressure instead of useful evidence
items.B: A scientific test of water quality
items.C: A balanced comparison of product features
items.D: A clear description of bottle materials
items.correct_text: Emotional pressure instead of useful evidence
items.feedback_correct: Excellent work! Naunawaan mo ang mahalagang clue sa tanong.
items.feedback_incorrect: You are improving! Balikan natin ang context bago pumili.
items.explanation: Ang ad ay gumagamit ng guilt or emotion para bumili. It does not provide evidence about product quality or safety.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: A barangay report shows that three streets flooded after drains filled with litter. Volunteers cleaned the drains; in the next moderate rain, those streets had less standing water.
items.question: Which conclusion is BEST supported by the report?
items.A: Keeping drains clear may reduce standing water.
items.B: All rainfall problems are caused by litter alone.
items.C: Flooding happens only in the three named streets.
items.D: Cleaning drains prevents every possible future flood.
items.correct_text: Keeping drains clear may reduce standing water.
items.feedback_correct: Great job! Tama ang iyong pagsusuri sa sitwasyon.
items.feedback_incorrect: Good attempt! Ihambing natin ang choices sa impormasyong ibinigay.
items.explanation: The observation suggests cleaning helped under those conditions. Hindi nito pinatutunayang wala nang anumang baha.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: The teacher said the task was simple, or easy enough to finish in ten minutes.
items.question: Which word helps explain “simple”?
items.A: Hard to begin today
items.B: Easy enough to finish
items.C: Impossible for the class
items.D: Unrelated to the task
items.correct_text: Easy enough to finish
items.feedback_correct: Well done! Naipakita mo ang magandang reading and reasoning skills.
items.feedback_incorrect: Keep going! Ang review na ito ay paraan para mas mahasa ang iyong skills.
items.explanation: The phrase “or easy enough” gives a synonym clue. Ibig sabihin, simple means not difficult in this sentence.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: After fixing the damaged garden fence, Rosa told her brother, “You are the heart of our team.”
items.question: What does “heart of our team” suggest?
items.A: He gives the group strength and encouragement.
items.B: He works only with medical equipment.
items.C: He cannot help without receiving a reward.
items.D: He is the youngest person in the group.
items.correct_text: He gives the group strength and encouragement.
items.feedback_correct: Mahusay! Nahanap mo ang sagot gamit ang context.
items.feedback_incorrect: You can do it! Suriin natin kung bakit mas angkop ang tamang sagot.
items.explanation: Figurative ang expression na heart of our team. It means an important, encouraging member, not the body organ.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: A learner writes to the school head to request the use of a classroom.
items.question: Which sentence uses an appropriate formal tone?
items.A: Hey, just give us that room today!
items.B: We will take the room without asking.
items.C: May we request permission to use the room?
items.D: Your room is ours, so move aside.
items.correct_text: May we request permission to use the room?
items.feedback_correct: Correct! Nagamit mo nang maayos ang lesson concept.
items.feedback_incorrect: Almost there! Gamitin ang explanation bilang guide sa susunod na item.
items.explanation: A respectful request uses polite language and states the purpose clearly. Ang formal audience ay nangangailangan ng courteous tone.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: Rain tapped softly on the roof. The lights were warm, and the family listened quietly to Grandmother’s stories.
items.question: What mood is created by the description?
items.A: A dangerous and confusing atmosphere
items.B: An angry and frightening atmosphere
items.C: A calm, peaceful, and comforting atmosphere
items.D: A noisy and competitive atmosphere
items.correct_text: A calm, peaceful, and comforting atmosphere
items.feedback_correct: Nice work! Tama ang iyong pagpili batay sa details.
items.feedback_incorrect: Good effort! Basahin natin muli ang mga clue at ang explanation.
items.explanation: Words such as softly, warm, and quietly create a peaceful mood. Ito ang feeling na nararanasan ng reader.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: The volunteers ____ the room before the program begins.
items.question: Which word completes the sentence correctly?
items.A: arranges
items.B: has arranged
items.C: arrange
items.D: arranging
items.correct_text: arrange
items.feedback_correct: Good thinking! Nasuri mo ang impormasyon nang mabuti.
items.feedback_incorrect: Keep learning! Tingnan natin kung aling detalye ang pinakamahalaga.
items.explanation: Plural ang subject na volunteers, kaya ang base verb na arrange ang tama. The other forms do not fit subject–verb agreement here.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: The learners prepared a short survey. ____ , they asked ten families to answer it. Finally, they summarized the results.
items.question: Which transition BEST shows the sequence?
items.A: Because, they lost the survey
items.B: Instead, they canceled the activity
items.C: However, the survey was irrelevant
items.D: Next, they visited the families
items.correct_text: Next, they visited the families
items.feedback_correct: You got it! Malinaw ang pag-unawa mo sa halimbawa.
items.feedback_incorrect: Nice try! Gamitin natin ang paliwanag para mas malinaw ang concept.
items.explanation: Next shows the step after preparing the survey. Ang transition ay tumutulong sa logical order ng ideas.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: A paragraph begins, “Our community needs clean drinking water.” The next sentences give reasons and examples.
items.question: What is the role of the opening sentence?
items.A: It changes the topic without warning.
items.B: It lists the supporting details in full.
items.C: It introduces the main idea of the paragraph before examples.
items.D: It repeats the closing statement exactly.
items.correct_text: It introduces the main idea of the paragraph before examples.
items.feedback_correct: Excellent work! Naunawaan mo ang mahalagang clue sa tanong.
items.feedback_incorrect: You are improving! Balikan natin ang context bago pumili.
items.explanation: The opening states the main idea that later sentences explain. Ito ang function ng introduction or topic sentence.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: A learner writes: (1) First, prepare the seeds. (2) Then, place them in soil. (3) Finally, water them lightly.
items.question: Why is the paragraph easy to follow?
items.A: The paragraph uses difficult and unfamiliar words.
items.B: The steps are hidden in random order.
items.C: The sentences mention several unrelated topics.
items.D: The steps are arranged in time order.
items.correct_text: The steps are arranged in time order.
items.feedback_correct: Great job! Tama ang iyong pagsusuri sa sitwasyon.
items.feedback_incorrect: Good attempt! Ihambing natin ang choices sa impormasyong ibinigay.
items.explanation: Ginamit ang first, then, at finally upang maipakita ang order. A clear sequence improves coherence in procedural writing.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: An ALS learner will explain recycling to a group of younger children.
items.question: Which approach BEST fits the audience?
items.A: Use advanced terms without explaining their meanings.
items.B: Speak only about experiences of office managers.
items.C: Read a complicated report without any examples.
items.D: Use familiar words and simple everyday examples.
items.correct_text: Use familiar words and simple everyday examples.
items.feedback_correct: Well done! Naipakita mo ang magandang reading and reasoning skills.
items.feedback_incorrect: Keep going! Ang review na ito ay paraan para mas mahasa ang iyong skills.
items.explanation: Child-friendly words and examples match the audience. Mahalaga ang audience at purpose kapag pumipili ng language.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: A learner listens while a classmate explains a problem.
items.question: Which behavior most clearly shows attention?
items.A: Walking out without saying a word
items.B: Looking away and covering both ears
items.C: Facing the speaker and nodding occasionally
items.D: Turning around to check another conversation
items.correct_text: Facing the speaker and nodding occasionally
items.feedback_correct: Mahusay! Nahanap mo ang sagot gamit ang context.
items.feedback_incorrect: You can do it! Suriin natin kung bakit mas angkop ang tamang sagot.
items.explanation: Facing the speaker and nodding can show attentive listening. Dapat ding iangkop ang eye contact sa comfort at culture ng kausap.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: A registration form asks for “Emergency Contact Number.”
items.question: What should a learner write in that field?
items.A: The school year of the current learner
items.B: The learner’s favorite subject at school
items.C: The phone number of a trusted emergency contact person
items.D: The address of the nearby library
items.correct_text: The phone number of a trusted emergency contact person
items.feedback_correct: Correct! Nagamit mo nang maayos ang lesson concept.
items.feedback_incorrect: Almost there! Gamitin ang explanation bilang guide sa susunod na item.
items.explanation: The field requests a phone number for emergencies. Ilagay ang correct number of an appropriate contact person.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: On an application form, the applicant’s birth date is 04 June 2009, but a draft entry says 04 July 2009.
items.question: What should the applicant do before submission?
items.A: Change the year to make it shorter.
items.B: Correct the month to match the record.
items.C: Leave the entire date field completely blank.
items.D: Submit the draft because the day matches.
items.correct_text: Correct the month to match the record.
items.feedback_correct: Nice work! Tama ang iyong pagpili batay sa details.
items.feedback_incorrect: Good effort! Basahin natin muli ang mga clue at ang explanation.
items.explanation: Kailangang tumugma ang date sa verified record. Even a wrong month can cause problems in official forms.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: A group wants to learn how learners travel to the learning center.
items.question: Which survey question is the clearest?
items.A: Would you agree that buses are terrible?
items.B: How do you usually travel to the center?
items.C: Why is riding a bicycle the best?
items.D: Do you always love your walk to class?
items.correct_text: How do you usually travel to the center?
items.feedback_correct: Good thinking! Nasuri mo ang impormasyon nang mabuti.
items.feedback_incorrect: Keep learning! Tingnan natin kung aling detalye ang pinakamahalaga.
items.explanation: Neutral at direct ang question tungkol sa travel method. It does not push respondents toward a preferred answer.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: A barangay team wants to ask families about access to safe water. A draft survey requests full names, passwords, and income details, although these are unnecessary.
items.question: What is the BEST improvement to the survey?
items.A: Ask only relevant questions and carefully protect private information.
items.B: Remove the water questions and request bank details.
items.C: Collect all passwords to make responses more complete.
items.D: Share personal details publicly to encourage participation.
items.correct_text: Ask only relevant questions and carefully protect private information.
items.feedback_correct: You got it! Malinaw ang pag-unawa mo sa halimbawa.
items.feedback_incorrect: Nice try! Gamitin natin ang paliwanag para mas malinaw ang concept.
items.explanation: A good survey follows data minimization: collect only what is needed. Pinoprotektahan nito ang privacy ng participants.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: A community poster celebrates different local traditions.
items.question: Which design choice is most appropriate?
items.A: Place offensive labels beside minority cultural practices.
items.B: Use a mocking cartoon as the main image.
items.C: Use costumes to make one group look foolish.
items.D: Show each tradition respectfully with accurate captions.
items.correct_text: Show each tradition respectfully with accurate captions.
items.feedback_correct: Excellent work! Naunawaan mo ang mahalagang clue sa tanong.
items.feedback_incorrect: You are improving! Balikan natin ang context bago pumili.
items.explanation: Respectful images and accurate captions avoid harmful stereotypes. Mahalaga ang cultural sensitivity sa visual communication.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: An infographic about a local festival shows a sacred symbol. The designer plans to recolor it for humor without asking community representatives.
items.question: What should the designer do FIRST?
items.A: Change the symbol immediately to make the poster more amusing.
items.B: Publish the design quickly before anyone can comment on it.
items.C: Remove cultural context and give the symbol an invented meaning.
items.D: Check the symbol’s meaning and consult appropriate community members.
items.correct_text: Check the symbol’s meaning and consult appropriate community members.
items.feedback_correct: Great job! Tama ang iyong pagsusuri sa sitwasyon.
items.feedback_incorrect: Good attempt! Ihambing natin ang choices sa impormasyong ibinigay.
items.explanation: Cultural symbols have meanings that may need respectful handling. Research and consultation help prevent misrepresentation.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: A poster’s heading is printed in very small letters, while decoration covers most of the page.
items.question: What change would improve readability?
items.A: Place the title behind a colorful image.
items.B: Make the heading clearer and reduce decoration around it.
items.C: Add more pictures over the important words.
items.D: Use smaller letters for every line of text.
items.correct_text: Make the heading clearer and reduce decoration around it.
items.feedback_correct: Well done! Naipakita mo ang magandang reading and reasoning skills.
items.feedback_incorrect: Keep going! Ang review na ito ay paraan para mas mahasa ang iyong skills.
items.explanation: Good visual hierarchy makes important information easy to notice. Larger clear titles improve readability.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: An infographic says: “Out of 40 families, 25 use refillable water containers.” It shows 25 filled symbols and 15 unfilled symbols.
items.question: What do the 25 filled symbols represent?
items.A: Families that do not have any containers
items.B: Families who refuse to answer the survey
items.C: Families that own more than 40 containers
items.D: Families that use refillable water containers
items.correct_text: Families that use refillable water containers
items.feedback_correct: Mahusay! Nahanap mo ang sagot gamit ang context.
items.feedback_incorrect: You can do it! Suriin natin kung bakit mas angkop ang tamang sagot.
items.explanation: The filled symbols match the 25 reported users. Ipinapakita ng visuals ang bilang, hindi ibang personal details.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: A health lesson combines a recorded voice, short captions, and drawings.
items.question: Which statement BEST describes the lesson?
items.A: It combines audio, text, and visual elements.
items.B: It relies on numbers without other media.
items.C: It uses only written words and no sound.
items.D: It contains only moving images with no text.
items.correct_text: It combines audio, text, and visual elements.
items.feedback_correct: Correct! Nagamit mo nang maayos ang lesson concept.
items.feedback_incorrect: Almost there! Gamitin ang explanation bilang guide sa susunod na item.
items.explanation: Multimedia uses more than one type of media. May audio, text, at drawings sa example.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: An ALS group makes a video about flood preparedness. Some viewers may have difficulty hearing, and others use small phone screens.
items.question: Which improvement BEST supports more viewers?
items.A: Show tiny text quickly without any written summary.
items.B: Add readable captions and clear high-contrast visual steps.
items.C: Use music alone while removing all the spoken directions.
items.D: Replace the instructions with decorative images of storms.
items.correct_text: Add readable captions and clear high-contrast visual steps.
items.feedback_correct: Nice work! Tama ang iyong pagpili batay sa details.
items.feedback_incorrect: Good effort! Basahin natin muli ang mga clue at ang explanation.
items.explanation: Captions help viewers follow audio content; readable visuals help on small screens. Accessibility strengthens the message for more learners.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.B: She feels nervous about performing publicly.

items.feedback_correct: Mahusay! Nahanap mo ang sagot gamit ang context.

items.B: Uncertain and confused about the volunteers
items.C: Thankful and respectful toward the volunteers
items.D: Suspicious and fearful of the volunteers
items.correct_text: Thankful and respectful toward the volunteers
items.feedback_correct: Great job! Tama ang iyong pagsusuri sa sitwasyon.
items.feedback_incorrect: Good attempt! Ihambing natin ang choices sa impormasyong ibinigay.
items.explanation: Words such as grateful and made a difference show appreciation. Ito ang evidence for the thankful tone.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: Every learner ____ a chance to join the activity.
items.question: Which word correctly completes the sentence?
items.A: has
items.B: have
items.C: are
items.D: having
items.correct_text: has
items.feedback_correct: Well done! Naipakita mo ang magandang reading and reasoning skills.
items.feedback_incorrect: Keep going! Ang review na ito ay paraan para mas mahasa ang iyong skills.
items.explanation: Every learner is singular in this sentence, so has is appropriate. Tandaan ang subject–verb agreement.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: A learner writes directions for visitors to find the learning center.
items.question: Which instruction is the clearest and most useful?
items.A: Just keep going anywhere until a classroom appears nearby.
items.B: Turn left at the clinic, then walk to the blue gate.
items.C: You might find it after going around for a while.
items.D: There is a place somewhere near some street and building.
items.correct_text: Turn left at the clinic, then walk to the blue gate.
items.feedback_correct: Mahusay! Nahanap mo ang sagot gamit ang context.
items.feedback_incorrect: You can do it! Suriin natin kung bakit mas angkop ang tamang sagot.
items.explanation: Specific landmarks and ordered steps make directions clear. The other choices lack precise guidance.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: A short report gives the topic in the first paragraph, details in the second, and a final recommendation in the last.
items.question: Which paragraph contains the conclusion?
items.A: The second paragraph listing supporting details
items.B: The heading above the whole short report
items.C: The first paragraph introducing the topic
items.D: The last paragraph with the recommendation
items.correct_text: The last paragraph with the recommendation
items.feedback_correct: Correct! Nagamit mo nang maayos ang lesson concept.
items.feedback_incorrect: Almost there! Gamitin ang explanation bilang guide sa susunod na item.
items.explanation: The last paragraph wraps up the report with a recommendation. Ito ang function ng conclusion.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: A learner describes the benefits of community reading sessions, giving examples of improved vocabulary and friendship.
items.question: Which final sentence BEST concludes the paragraph?
items.A: The community reading center has several different kinds of chairs.
items.B: Some books have bright covers while others are plain.
items.C: A new store opened across the road last weekend.
items.D: Reading sessions help learners grow and connect with others.
items.correct_text: Reading sessions help learners grow and connect with others.
items.feedback_correct: Nice work! Tama ang iyong pagpili batay sa details.
items.feedback_incorrect: Good effort! Basahin natin muli ang mga clue at ang explanation.
items.explanation: The best closing sentence returns to the main point: learning and connection. Hindi ito nagdadagdag ng unrelated idea.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: An ALS facilitator prepares an announcement for learners of different ages and backgrounds.
items.question: Which message is most suitable for everyone?
items.A: New learners who need help should stay away.
items.B: All learners are invited to the free orientation.
items.C: Only the fastest readers should attend the meeting.
items.D: People from other communities are not welcome here.
items.correct_text: All learners are invited to the free orientation.
items.feedback_correct: Good thinking! Nasuri mo ang impormasyon nang mabuti.
items.feedback_incorrect: Keep learning! Tingnan natin kung aling detalye ang pinakamahalaga.
items.explanation: Inclusive wording addresses learners respectfully, regardless of background. Ang message ay clear at welcoming.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: A teammate looks puzzled while a learner explains instructions.
items.question: What should the learner do next?
items.A: Continue faster without checking their response
items.B: Assume the teammate understood every detail
items.C: Ask if the teammate needs clarification
items.D: Laugh because the teammate looks confused
items.correct_text: Ask if the teammate needs clarification
items.feedback_correct: You got it! Malinaw ang pag-unawa mo sa halimbawa.
items.feedback_incorrect: Nice try! Gamitin natin ang paliwanag para mas malinaw ang concept.
items.explanation: A puzzled expression can signal confusion. Asking respectfully checks understanding without making assumptions.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: A survey form asks, “What is your preferred way to receive learning materials?”
items.question: Which response fits the question?
items.A: A favorite meal prepared for the family
items.B: Printed learning modules delivered to the local community learning center.
items.C: The date of a school sports festival
items.D: A contact person’s full home address
items.correct_text: Printed learning modules delivered to the local community learning center.
items.feedback_correct: Excellent work! Naunawaan mo ang mahalagang clue sa tanong.
items.feedback_incorrect: You are improving! Balikan natin ang context bago pumili.
items.explanation: The question asks for delivery or access preference. Printed modules are a relevant answer; the rest are unrelated.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: A learner’s application says “Grade completed: Grade 6,” but the attached verified school record says Grade 5.
items.question: What is the BEST action before submission?
items.A: Delete the school record and submit the form anyway.
items.B: Keep the higher grade to improve the application.
items.C: Check the record and correct the form accurately.
items.D: Ask a friend to invent a different school document.
items.correct_text: Check the record and correct the form accurately.
items.feedback_correct: Great job! Tama ang iyong pagsusuri sa sitwasyon.
items.feedback_incorrect: Good attempt! Ihambing natin ang choices sa impormasyong ibinigay.
items.explanation: Forms should reflect verified information. Kapag may mismatch, confirm and correct before submission.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: A community group wants to know how often households separate biodegradable waste.
items.question: Which survey item avoids leading the respondent?
items.A: How often do you separate biodegradable waste?
items.B: Would you admit that your household is irresponsible?
items.C: Why do only careless families fail to segregate?
items.D: Do you agree that everyone must always segregate?
items.correct_text: How often do you separate biodegradable waste?
items.feedback_correct: Well done! Naipakita mo ang magandang reading and reasoning skills.
items.feedback_incorrect: Keep going! Ang review na ito ay paraan para mas mahasa ang iyong skills.
items.explanation: The frequency question is neutral and specific. Hindi nito pinipilit ang respondent sa isang answer.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: A learner surveys ten neighbors about library use. Each question has two unrelated parts, and some responses cannot be understood.
items.question: What change would MOST improve the survey?
items.A: Revise each question to ask one clear idea at a time.
items.B: Add more unrelated topics to every survey question.
items.C: Use longer technical terms to impress the respondents.
items.D: Ignore confusing responses and keep the original questions.
items.correct_text: Revise each question to ask one clear idea at a time.
items.feedback_correct: Mahusay! Nahanap mo ang sagot gamit ang context.
items.feedback_incorrect: You can do it! Suriin natin kung bakit mas angkop ang tamang sagot.
items.explanation: Single-focus questions make answers easier to interpret. Clear questions help collect reliable and meaningful data.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: An information board shows traditional clothing from several Philippine communities.
items.question: Which label is the most respectful?
items.A: Strange outfits worn by people who are less modern
items.B: Traditional clothing shared by different cultural communities
items.C: Funny clothes that should never be used again
items.D: Costumes proving one community is better than others
items.correct_text: Traditional clothing shared by different cultural communities
items.feedback_correct: Correct! Nagamit mo nang maayos ang lesson concept.
items.feedback_incorrect: Almost there! Gamitin ang explanation bilang guide sa susunod na item.
items.explanation: A neutral accurate label respects cultural differences. Avoid language that belittles or ranks communities.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.focus: Visual communication for a sensitive event
items.stimulus: A poster honors the victims of a recent community disaster. The designer considers bright comic stickers, playful captions, and a quiet remembrance image.
items.question: Which design decision BEST fits the purpose?
items.A: Focus on jokes rather than the purpose of the memorial.
items.B: Add funny stickers to make the tragedy seem entertaining.
items.C: Use sensational pictures without considering affected families.
items.D: Use respectful imagery and clear information about the memorial.
items.correct_text: Use respectful imagery and clear information about the memorial.
items.feedback_correct: Nice work! Tama ang iyong pagpili batay sa details.
items.feedback_incorrect: Good effort! Basahin natin muli ang mga clue at ang explanation.
items.explanation: The poster’s tone should respect people affected by tragedy. Ang visual design ay dapat bagay sa purpose at audience.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: A school poster places the event date in small letters at the bottom. Many readers miss it.
items.question: What should the designer change?
items.A: Hide the date beneath the background image.
items.B: Make the date larger and easier to locate.
items.C: Use smaller letters for the event date.
items.D: Replace the date with unrelated decorations.
items.correct_text: Make the date larger and easier to locate.
items.feedback_correct: Good thinking! Nasuri mo ang impormasyon nang mabuti.
items.feedback_incorrect: Keep learning! Tingnan natin kung aling detalye ang pinakamahalaga.
items.explanation: Important details need visible placement and readable size. Ito ang principle of visual hierarchy.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: A chart titled “Daily Reading Time” shows: Monday 20 minutes, Tuesday 15 minutes, Wednesday 30 minutes, Thursday 25 minutes.
items.question: What does the chart show about Wednesday?
items.A: It has the lowest recorded reading time.
items.B: It has the same reading time as Tuesday.
items.C: It has the highest recorded reading time.
items.D: It has no reported reading minutes at all.
items.correct_text: It has the highest recorded reading time.
items.feedback_correct: You got it! Malinaw ang pag-unawa mo sa halimbawa.
items.feedback_incorrect: Nice try! Gamitin natin ang paliwanag para mas malinaw ang concept.
items.explanation: 30 minutes is higher than 20, 15, and 25. Basahin ang data bago mag-interpret ng chart.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: A video lesson uses diagrams, spoken explanations, and subtitles to teach planting.
items.question: How do subtitles help viewers understand?
items.A: They prevent viewers from watching the planting steps.
items.B: They remove the need for accurate spoken explanations.
items.C: They show important spoken information as written text.
items.D: They replace the diagrams with unrelated photographs.
items.correct_text: They show important spoken information as written text.
items.feedback_correct: Excellent work! Naunawaan mo ang mahalagang clue sa tanong.
items.feedback_incorrect: You are improving! Balikan natin ang context bago pumili.
items.explanation: Subtitles present spoken content in readable text. This improves access for viewers in noisy or quiet settings.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending

items.stimulus: A group prepares an online announcement about a free learning session. The video has loud background music, tiny text, and no visible schedule.
items.question: Which revision would MOST improve communication?
items.A: Replace the schedule with faster moving decorative effects.
items.B: Increase music volume and remove the spoken details.
items.C: Reduce music volume and display a readable schedule throughout the video.
items.D: Keep the announcement unchanged even if viewers miss details.
items.correct_text: Reduce music volume and display a readable schedule throughout the video.
items.feedback_correct: Great job! Tama ang iyong pagsusuri sa sitwasyon.
items.feedback_incorrect: Good attempt! Ihambing natin ang choices sa impormasyong ibinigay.
items.explanation: The audience needs to hear and read the key details. Lower music and a visible schedule make the announcement clearer.
items.review_status: Draft - subject-matter validation and learner pilot pending
